ns2:course.label: Painting I
ns2:course.description: Familiarizes students with basic oil painting materials, techniques, and concepts. Topics include composition, color theory, historical painting techniques, illusionistic space, and paint handling and application. Exploration and discussion of the ways in which paintings make meaning. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTF 102, ARTF 104.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. Prerequisite: ARTF 102, ARTF 104.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or New Media major(s).
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For Art majors only. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
